body: Attempt 3 `npm run coverage` ran once: all 11,156 tests passed, but branch coverage is 94.87% (15,436/16,270) against 95%, so 21 additional branches are needed. Largest sprint-file gaps are `chatHandlers.ts` (19/84 uncovered), `conversationMessage.ts` (10/35), `AgentsSection.tsx` (6/35), `ConversationPanel.tsx` (5/40), and `KanbanCardPanel.tsx` (4/77); `bootstrap.ts` wiring reports 36/36 uncovered. A future retry must add consumer-visible edge coverage rather than lowering the threshold or excluding code.
